record.field: for rec in self: rec['x_studio_bike_count'] = self.env['x_bikes'].search_count([('x_studio_bike_model', '=', rec.id)])
for rec in self: rec['x_studio_model_count'] = self.env['x_bike_models'].search_count([('x_studio_manufacturer', '=', rec.id)])
for rec in self: rec['x_studio_total_amount'] = (rec.x_studio_amount or 0.0) + (rec.x_studio_late_fee_amount or 0.0)

for rec in self: dep = rec.x_studio_lease_plan.x_studio_security_deposit if rec.x_studio_lease_plan else 0.0 repair = rec.x_studio_repair_charge or 0.0 rec['x_studio_refund_amount'] = max(0.0, dep - repair)

for rec in self: dep = rec.x_studio_lease_plan.x_studio_security_deposit if rec.x_studio_lease_plan else 0.0 repair = rec.x_studio_repair_charge or 0.0 rec['x_studio_extra_charge'] = max(0.0, repair - dep)
